label: sec:classical-limit-implications-preamble
html:
The previous sub-section established the classical-limit functor and its substrate-level constructions. The consequences follow. The graded Baer-star structure on \mathcal{H}_q descends through the two-filtration bridge to relate the Gröbner--Shirshov depth filtration to Goncharov's period filtration, producing the classical Riemann zeta as a q = 1 limit of the q-zeta primitive. The Riemann hypothesis surfaces as a statement about a specific filtration height. The adelic Tate squeeze closes the chapter as the surreal-bound infrastructure consumed by the appendix-surreal Millennium bounds.

The sub-section ends with the chapter outro, preparing the archimedean-universe specialisation in the next chapter.
